title: Northbeam TechWorks Mileage Note: Distance Charges a Contract Does Not Leave
content:
How much of the charge for the distance travelled is added to a business contract relief on a Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair job is read from the day each such charge was booked for.

**Where such a charge stands on the job for the day the crew was dispatched**, that charge is added.

**Where such charges stand on the job only for days other than the day the crew was dispatched**, the charges standing on the job less those booked for the day the crew was dispatched are added.

**Where neither situation holds**, nothing of the charge for the distance travelled is added.

## The readings side by side

| Charges for the distance travelled standing on the job | Added |
| --- | --- |
| one or more booked for the day the crew was dispatched | the charges booked for that day |
| one or more, none of them for that day | the charges standing on the job, less those booked for that day — that is, all of them |
| none at all | nothing |

The first reading takes precedence: where any such charge is booked for the day the crew was dispatched, that is what is added, and the charges of other days are not.

## Illustrations on hypothetical jobs

*The amounts below are chosen for the illustration and are not figures of any job on file.*

**No distance charge at all.** Nothing is added.

**Distance charges on other days only.** A hypothetical job carries 31.20 USD and 20.40 USD for the distance travelled, neither booked for the day the crew was dispatched. The second reading governs: the charges standing on the job, 51.60 USD, less nothing booked for that day, so 51.60 USD is added.

**A distance charge on the dispatch day.** The same job also carries 52.80 USD booked for the day the crew was dispatched. The first reading governs and 52.80 USD is added.
